instructions: Follow AGENTS.md and CONVENTIONS.md strictly. Bun only, Cloudflare Workers runtime (not Node.js), single Worker serving a React SPA plus a Hono API under /api.
ignorePatterns:
src/react-app/routeTree.gen.ts
worker-configuration.d.ts
bun.lock
public/**
dist/**
coverage/**
**/test-results/**
**/playwright-report/**
.wrangler/**

rules.rule: All styling must use CSS Modules. No inline style={} props, no CSS-in-JS.
No useEffect for data fetching — use TanStack Query (useQuery/useMutation).
Cloudflare Workers runtime - no Node-only APIs (fs, path, process.env directly). Validate all inputs at the handler layer before touching storage.
